# Inter Sports Infra LLP

> Inter Sports Infra LLP designs and builds sports surfaces and the civil works beneath them in India: football turf, pickleball, badminton, basketball and tennis courts, athletics tracks, and indoor sports flooring. Based in Faridabad, Haryana. One contractor handles site survey, design, civil works, surfacing, line marking, equipment and annual maintenance.

## Contact
- Address: 272, First Floor, Sector 8, Faridabad, Ballabhgarh, Haryana 121004, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 92179 81815
- Email: intersportsinfra@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.intersportsinfra.com/

## Service area
Delhi NCR (Faridabad, Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, New Delhi), Mumbai, Bangalore, Guwahati and the North East.

## Services
- [Football turf](https://www.intersportsinfra.com/football-turf/): 5-a-side to full-size artificial grass pitches, shock pad, drainage
- [Pickleball courts](https://www.intersportsinfra.com/pickleball-courts/): multi-coat acrylic courts with line marking
- [Badminton courts](https://www.intersportsinfra.com/badminton-courts/): indoor vinyl and wooden flooring
- [Basketball courts](https://www.intersportsinfra.com/basketball-courts/): acrylic outdoor courts and indoor floors
- [Tennis courts](https://www.intersportsinfra.com/tennis-courts/): new acrylic hard courts and resurfacing
- [All services](https://www.intersportsinfra.com/services/): civil works, design and build, athletics tracks (EPDM/PU), equipment, floodlighting
- [Maintenance](https://www.intersportsinfra.com/maintenance/): annual care plans, including for surfaces built by other contractors

## How a project runs
Free site visit, then layout drawings and written specification, then a fixed-scope itemised quote, then construction, joint measurement at handover, and an optional annual maintenance plan. A layout and indicative cost is provided within three working days of receiving site dimensions and the sport.
